title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 23 in B major

character.text: Four-voice fugue built on harmonic proportions; not a verset type

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times). Alto: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence rising by a seventh every half bar. Bass: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1. Returns in Episode 2 (bars 13–15). Returns in Episode 3 (bars 25–28).

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 9–11) in part, with the soprano's line in the alto, the alto's line in the soprano, the bass's line in the tenor, transposed. Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1 (3 times). Bass: free counterpoint.

sections.label: Link
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.

sections.label: Subject in B major, inverted (Alto); Subject in B major (Bass)
Link
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: the opening of countersubject 1.

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 9–11) in part, with the alto's line in the tenor, a fifth lower. Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Bass: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted.

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1. Bass: the opening of countersubject 1.
